$comment: An example .claude/settings.json that wires both hooks in. Copy guard.js, subagent-guard.js and the lib/ folder to .claude/hooks/ in your repository (guard.js requires lib/ beside it), merge this into your settings, and commit all of it so every session inherits them. The permission lists are prefix matches on the first command; the hooks judge the whole line. The hooks fail closed by themselves (exit 2 with a G17 reason when they cannot load or read); onFailure: block, read by Claude Code 2.1.295 and later, is the second layer, for a hook process that cannot start at all.

env.$comment: Caps Claude Code can enforce itself. The subagent guard adds the one it cannot: a total per session. With no model pin, every subagent call has to name its model, and the guard makes sure it does.
